def allocation_scope(reader, registration, release):
    """Enforce the reviewed one-identity allocation before reservation."""
    extension_ref = {'path':'CUMULATIVE_EXTENSION05_DRAFT01.json',
                     'sha256':'c161983c753a1aa17fabbe7f3af3f4f6017b59e81d10e667075c661356ef0c1d'}
    review_ref = {'path':'CUMULATIVE_REVIEW01.json',
                  'sha256':'7ec00d22ec0edff27032cbc3328b12dbf95a5ed4d1aac4a7170704df9d61f63d'}
    expected = {'extension':extension_ref, 'review':review_ref}
    require(registration['experiments'][IDENTITY]['cumulative_budget_extension'] == expected,
            'selected single canonical allocation differs')
    adopters = [name for name, exp in registration['experiments'].items()
                if exp.get('cumulative_budget_extension') == expected]
    require(adopters == [IDENTITY], 'extension admits another identity')
    extension = parse(reference(reader, extension_ref))
    require(extension['initial_experiment'] == IDENTITY and extension['cumulative_ceiling'] == 7
            and extension['consumed_before'] == 5, 'fixed original cumulative scope differs')
    allocation_ref = {'path':'CUMULATIVE_ALLOCATION05_DRAFT01.json',
                      'sha256':'0673e21c83475cfebe48c57f3176a746fed70b6f001f2284646d3c47fe05f097'}
    require(extension['allocation'] == allocation_ref, 'allocation body reference differs')
    allocation = parse(reference(reader, allocation_ref))
    attempts = allocation['new_attempts']
    require(len(attempts) == 1 and attempts[0]['identity'] == IDENTITY
            and attempts[0]['parent'] is None and attempts[0]['maximum_claims'] == 1,
            'one independent fresh success allocation required')
    conditional = 'original-import-held-publication-failure-20261003-01'
    require(release['cases']['second_target_publication_failure']['identity'] == conditional
            and release['cases']['second_target_publication_failure']['disposition'] == 'unavailable-original-companion-failed'
            and len(allocation['retained_unclaimed_unavailable']) == 1
            and allocation['retained_unclaimed_unavailable'][0]['identity'] == conditional,
            'old conditional slot must remain unavailable and nontransferable')
